pr_title: Fix unifiprotect smart detection when end is set
pr_body:
## Proposed change
<!--
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the
  additional information section.
-->
If the end message and the smart detection are in the same message because the smart event is detected late we need to write the smart detection and than clear it right away since we will never get an end message for the detection.

Currently the logic would ignore any smart detection that had the end set on the message which meant ~20% of smart detections are never seen.

fixes #119306 fixes #119444

issue_context.title: UniFi Protect License Plate Detection Inconsistent in Home Assistant
issue_context.body:
### The problem

I am experiencing an issue with my Home Assistant setup where the UniFi Protect License Plate detection sensor is not updating consistently. While the UniFi camera detects license plates correctly, this detection is not reliably reflected in Home Assistant.

- The UniFi Protect camera detects license plates, but the corresponding sensor in Home Assistant is not updated (or incorrectly - see attached
[unifiprotect.pdf](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/15777012/unifiprotect.pdf)
).
- This issue is intermittent; sometimes the sensor updates correctly, but at other times it does not.
- There are no error logs or warnings in Home Assistant when the license plate detection fails to show.

- I have verified the camera settings and confirmed that license plate detection is enabled. 
- I have checked the Home Assistant configuration and ensured that the UniFi Protect integration is set up correctly.
-  have restarted both Home Assistant and the UniFi Protect system to see if the issue resolves temporarily, but the problem persists.

UniFi OS 3.2.12  Protect 4.0.21  (Camera AI Bullet Firmware Version 4.71.85)




### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2024.6.1

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Container

### Integration causing the issue

unifiprotect

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/unifiprotect
